# dagsterplus_team_branch_deployments_grant (Resource)

Manages a permission grant for a Dagster+ team across all branch deployments of a specific parent (full) deployment. If you manage the team with dagsterplus_team, prefer the inline branch_deployments_grant block instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_team_branch_deployments_grant" "data_eng_prod_branches" {
  team_id           = dagsterplus_team.data_engineering.id
  parent_deployment = "prod"
  grant             = "EDITOR"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent_deployment` (String) The name of the full (parent) deployment whose branch deployments this grant applies to.
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team to grant access.

### Optional

- `custom_role_id` (String) The ID of a custom role to assign. Conflicts with grant.
- `grant` (String) Standard permission level: `VIEWER`, `LAUNCHER`, `EDITOR`, or `ADMIN`. Conflicts with custom_role_id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier in the form `{team_id}/{parent_deployment}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using {team_id}/{parent_deployment}.
terraform import dagsterplus_team_branch_deployments_grant.example <team_id>/<parent_deployment_name>
```
